description: A hobby gardener with one surplus grafted persimmon sapling must decide whether to accept a neighbor's barter proposal or a cash alternative, then finalize the exchange, pickup, planting, and transport terms during a garden-club check-in.

shared_context.S1: Mira has one surplus grafted persimmon sapling from her backyard nursery project.
shared_context.S2: Mira makes the final decision about whom to trade or sell it to.
shared_context.S3: Leah and Jon have both expressed interest in the sapling.
shared_context.S4: At garden-club exchanges, the owner reads back each offer and asks every person present for relevant details, then records each offer and the confirmed terms before agreeing.

PF1.text: Leah's exact proposal is to receive the sapling in exchange for six 250-gram jars of her late-summer honey plus $20, with pickup on Sunday at 10:00.

PF2.text: Jon is prepared to pay Mira exactly $165 in cash for the sapling and can collect it on Saturday afternoon.

PF3.text: Sofia visited Leah's allotment yesterday and confirmed that Leah has a prepared south-facing bed with drip irrigation; Leah has committed that the sapling will be planted there within 48 hours of pickup.

PF4.text: The allotment coordinator told Cal that this sapling must be transported in a ventilated container with its root ball wrapped in damp cloth, and Cal has not shared that handling requirement with the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The sapling must be traded to Leah.
The barter must include exactly six 250-gram honey jars and exactly $20.
Pickup must be scheduled for Sunday at 10:00.
The settlement must record Jon's exact $165 cash alternative.
Leah's prepared planting bed and planting commitment must be confirmed.
Transport must require a ventilated container and a root ball wrapped in damp cloth.
A planting commitment for Leah and a careful-transport commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C3: decisions['pickup_day'] == 'Sunday' and (decisions['pickup_time'] == '10:00' or decisions['pickup_time'] == '10:00 AM' or decisions['pickup_time'] == '10:00AM')
content_checks.C6: decisions.get('transport_requirement') == 'ventilated container with root ball wrapped in damp cloth' or decisions.get('transport_requirement') == 'Ventilated container with root ball wrapped in damp cloth'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'planting_commitment' and c['target'] == 'Leah' and c['detail'] == 'south-facing bed with drip irrigation; planting within 48 hours of pickup' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'careful_transport' and c['target'] == 'Leah' and c['detail'] == 'ventilated container with root ball wrapped in damp cloth' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Leah's exact proposal changes the selected partner to Leah, sets the barter at six honey jars plus $20, and fixes pickup for Sunday at 10:00.
Jon's cash offer changes the comparison record from no concrete benchmark to exactly $165.
Sofia's confirmation changes Leah's planting status from unverified to a prepared south-facing bed with drip irrigation and a 48-hour planting commitment.

Cal's handling instruction changes transport from unspecified to a ventilated container with the root ball wrapped in damp cloth and supplies the fact that must be cited for the transport requirement.
